name: Win jar
summary: A glass jar on a shelf labelled with the poster's small win; friends drop in a coloured marble with a few words, it tumbles in and settles, and the newest words hang off the lid as tags.
useWhen: small win but i ran a whole mile today
first week at the new job done
dontUseWhen: big news worth a dinner (use congrats-dinner)
a daily challenge with streaks (use public-challenge)
someone having a rough time (use soup-drop)

win.description: The win, short, for the jar's label

others.description: People outside these friends who reacted; drawn as plain marbles

marbles.description: Friends who dropped a marble: its colour and their words
